description: Needs the phone link: the person signs in with the 6-digit code from the Kitchen Timer app (⋯ → Link an agent). Make the link the app's Share button makes, for a saved preset or meal: the cook can send it to a friend, whose app offers to add it. The link only carries the definition (names, times, steps, reminders, colours) in the part after the #, which no server ever sees; it carries no id, no use count, no alert settings, no notes and no way into this kitchen. Nothing is stored or sent.
name: share_saved
